diagnosis: Metastasis of lobular breast carcinoma to endometrium
legend: Endometrial curettage performed for abnormal uterine bleeding in a patient without known breast cancer. The endometrial stroma is infiltrated by dyscohesive round atypical cells with eccentric nuclei. Origin from lobular breast carcinoma was confirmed by immunohistochemistry and clinical investigation.
